title: Sky Blue Hand Block Print Cotton Tunic Top for Women
color_custom: Sky blue with green & white anar (pomegranate) block print
description:
Fresh as a Jaipur morning. This sky-blue cotton tunic is hand block printed with a green and white anar (pomegranate) motif – calm, cheerful and easy to wear every day.

✦ The Details
• Mandarin band collar with a V placket and button front
• Soft pintucks at the front for a gentle flare
• 3/4 sleeves
• Hip length with a curved hem
• Easy pull-on style

✦ Fabric & Craft
100% cotton – soft, breathable and kind to skin. Hand block printed with carved wooden blocks; small variations are part of its handmade charm.

✦ Fit & Size
Regular, easy fit that skims the body. Choose your usual top size – size up for a relaxed, boxy look.

✦ How to Style It
Light wash jeans and white sneakers for college; beige trousers and a tan tote for office; white linen pants for summer holidays; silver jhumkas to dress it up.

✦ The Bahe Promise
• Made in Jaipur – we send you photos of your piece before it ships
• Free custom fit on request – share your measurements
• Free worldwide shipping to the USA, UK, Canada, UAE & Australia, with tracking
• Real people on WhatsApp to help with size and styling

The colour may look slightly different on your screen.
care: Gentle hand wash in cold water separately for the first wash. Do not bleach. Dry in shade and iron on medium heat on the reverse side.
